name: @klangk/chat
description: Workspace chat feature — chat tab and clanker agent UI

KLANGKWS_FEATURE_CHAT_AGENT_ENABLED.description: Enable the clanker agent in chat. Opt-in (default off / empty).

KLANGKWS_FEATURE_CHAT_AGENT_EMAIL.description: The email address the clanker agent acts as, when enabled.

KLANGKWS_FEATURE_CHAT_AGENT_HANDLE.description: The @-handle the clanker agent uses in chat, when enabled.
